lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in 6-8 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement exhibits a grid-like topology with consistent inter-centroid distances in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with horizontal rows of spots. These intersections form high-contrast nodes that anchor the lateral pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal carinae are present in the upper third of the flank. The most dorsal ridge shows a pronounced luminance gradient, with a high-intensity edge transitioning into a lower-intensity shadow region below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin macro-mask contains a high density of small, high-luminance blobs. These spots are more concentrated towards the base and leading edge, becoming sparser toward the apex and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots is visible in the area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, preceding the start of the primary grid pattern.
